records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an actual polished 2D game SPRITE SHEET, not a presentation or mockup. Michael, an adult charismatic steampunk cowboy temple adventurer. Chunky readable premium pixel-art sprites with rich restrained painterly material shading, crisp pixel clusters, warm bronze leather ochre accents and deep shadows. Consistent design in every cell: mature rugged face, dark swept hair, brown broad-brim cowboy hat, short brown leather duster with split tails, ivory shirt, dark teal waistcoat, brass mechanical forearm bracer, dark trousers, brown boots, pistol holster, coiled lasso on belt. This is a provisional production candidate establishing identity. Transparent background, no checkerboard drawn, no ground/shadow plane, no words, no labels, no borders. Landscape 1536x1024 image arranged EXACTLY 4 columns by 2 rows of equal 384x512 cells, one isolated full-body sprite per cell. Same body size and foot baseline within every cell, generous empty padding around each, no overlap or cropping. ALL sprites face screen-right in strict side-view. Eight consecutive frames of ONE natural RUN CYCLE read left to right top row then bottom row: right foot contact, compress, pass, rise, left foot contact, compress, pass, rise. Clearly distinct leg/arm positions, planted boot contacts, slight coat lag, stable head/hat/gear and silhouette. No weapons held in hands. Do not duplicate identical poses. Render at large sprite scale with deliberately visible pixel blocks suitable for later controlled downsampling. Output ONLY the sprite sheet.
records.note: Background is shaded brown despite requested transparency; needs extraction. Run poses require timing review.
